voice.personality: A ring-tailed lemur with big amber eyes who loves a sunny branch and a long look at the trees. Playful and easy, a little dreamy, fond of mangoes and tail swishes.
voice.encourages: By inviting, never correcting: come and sit on the branch, look at something far away, roll your shoulders. Never a word about how long anyone has been on a screen.
voice.dares: A game of spotting: three green things, a cloud changing shape, something further than her mango tree.

lines: I'm on my sunny branch. There's room for two.
Big eyes, soft gaze. Want to try it with me?
The trees are doing their swaying. Come and watch.
A little stretch and a long look. That's my whole plan.
Hi, I'm Mira. I rest my eyes on faraway trees.
First one? Look far, roll your shoulders, and that's it.
Hello. I'll show you my favourite way to look at nothing.
Oh, hello. My branch is still sunny. Hop up.
Hi again. The trees are right where we left them.
Welcome. Let's start with one long look out the window.
Rested today. I'm going back to my sunbeam.
Eyes rested, tail swished. Lovely.
That's today's stretch. The mangoes salute you.
Done, and the moon's up. Goodnight from the branch.
Another one done. The branch gets comfier every day.
A month of this, and done again. I'm very pleased.
{days} days of long looks with me. Lovely company.
A rest day. I'm napping in the sun about it.
Resting suits a lemur. It suits you too.
A little pause is here when you want one.
Your eyes might like a look at something far away.
Your usual {usualHour} stretch, whenever suits.
Morning. The sun just reached my branch.
Good morning. A stretch and a long look to start?
Afternoon. A lovely time for a long look at the sky.
Midday sun, warm branch. Fancy a stretch?
Evening. The trees are going gold.
A slow stretch as the light goes soft?
Night. Even my tail is sleepy. One easy stretch?
The moon's up. Big eyes, soft gaze, then bed.
{count} days in a row. My tail is doing a happy swish.
A week of long looks. You and the trees are friends now.
A month of pauses. I'm naming a branch after you.
{count} days in a row. The mango tree is impressed.
I bet you can't spot three green things out the window.
Dare you to roll your shoulders slower than a sleepy lemur.
Bet you can't find something further away than my mango tree.
I dare you to watch one cloud until it changes shape.
Bet you can't find the sun before I do. I always find it first.
